name: Shrine
description: Built on a place of significant spiritual relevance, a $shrine$ serves as a keeper of that spirituality and to organize worship of it.

name: Mountain
description: Mountains have always been seen as sources of the divine, and many are revered as holy ground or even as manifestation of gods themselves.

name: Temple
description: A $temple$ is a place of worship dedicated for the religious duties of the $clergy_estate$. Although temples can come in different shapes and forms depending on the local religion, its purpose remains all the same.

name: City
description: The very epitome of civilization, a City is a bustling metropolis of industry, great temples, and seats of governmental authority sprawled across multiple districts.

name: Episcopal See
description: An Episcopal See is the area of a Bishop's jurisdiction. They give added benefits to [countries|e] that control them.

name: Orthodox Holy Site
description: This is a [holy_site|e] important to all following the [ShowReligionName('orthodox')] faith.

name: Christian Holy Site
description: This is a [holy_site|e] important to [ShowReligionGroupAdjective('christian')] religions.

name: Inti Holy Site
description: This is a [holy_site|e] important to all following the [ShowReligionName('inti')] faith.

name: Mayan Holy Site
description: This is a [holy_site|e] important to all following the [ShowReligionName('mayan')] faith.

name: Islamic Holy Site
description: This is a [holy_site|e] important to all following the [ShowReligionGroupAdjective('muslim')] [religions|e].
